title: Kafka Fundamentals: Partitions, Consumer Groups, Offsets
trackerTask: Kafka fundamentals: partitions, consumer groups, offsets
recap: Kafka ek distributed append-only commit log hai jo partitions me divided hota hai. Same key ke messages hamesha same partition me jaate hain taaki order maintain rahe. Consumer groups independent offsets ke saath parallelly messages consume karte hain.

demos.title: Producer, topic and partitions
demos.summary: Same key, same partition: key se partition decide hota hai aur order guaranteed rehta hai.

demos.title: Consumers and groups
demos.summary: One consumer per partition: consumer group me har partition ka ek hi owner hota hai.

demos.title: Offsets and lag
demos.summary: Committed offset progress bookmark hai; lag consumer ka backlog batata hai.

demos.title: Rebalance
demos.summary: Consumer join ya crash hone par partition ownership rebalance hoti hai.

demos.title: Acks and replication
demos.summary: Leader broker writes handle karta hai; acks=all aur ISR data loss rokte hain.

demos.title: Retries and DLQ
demos.summary: Poison message partition block kar deta hai jab tak retry backoff aur DLQ na ho.
